schemaFaqHome.a1: Social Forex is a web platform with live forex-related quotes, an economic calendar, trading calculators, structured academy lessons, a forum, and optional trading signals. Everything is educational and informational, not personalized investment advice.
schemaFaqHome.q2: Do I need an account to use it?
schemaFaqHome.a2: You can browse many tools and pages such as live quotes, the economic calendar, and academy content without signing in. Some features like posting in the forum, signals, or private messages require registration.
schemaFaqHome.q3: Where should a complete beginner start?
schemaFaqHome.a3: Open Start here for a practical path: Exness registration, MetaTrader 5, a demo account, login, then a small XAUUSD practice trade on demo. Use the Academy for theory such as risk and spreads.
schemaFaqHome.q4: Are prices and calendar data guaranteed accurate?
schemaFaqHome.a4: No. Quotes and calendar entries depend on third-party data feeds and can be delayed, incomplete, or temporarily unavailable. Always confirm critical times and prices on your broker platform or official sources.
schemaFaqHome.a5: No. Forex and CFD trading carry a high risk of loss, including your full balance. Content on the site does not consider your personal situation; consult a licensed professional when needed.

start.metaDescription: Register Exness, install MT5, open a demo account, log in, then practice buying XAUUSD 0.01. Educational only — not investment advice.
start.affiliateNotice: The Exness registration link below is an affiliate link: we may earn a commission when you sign up, at no extra cost to you.
start.title: Start here — Exness & MetaTrader 5 (demo)
start.subtitle: A practical path for beginners: register with Exness, install MT5, create a demo account, log in, then place a tiny gold (XAUUSD) buy on demo.
start.intro: Educational only. Not investment advice. Trading can result in total loss. Demo uses virtual money. Live trading differs. If your broker screens differ, follow Exness and MetaQuotes official documentation.
start.signupPromptDesc: Create a free account to keep your watchlist, learning progress, and first journal notes together before you move to broker screens.
start.brokerStep1_body: Use the button below to open the Exness registration page (affiliate). Complete email verification and any identity checks requested. You need an Exness account before you can create a MetaTrader login and demo credentials.
start.brokerStep2_body: Desktop: download MetaTrader 5 from the official MetaQuotes site and install it. Mobile: install the app named "MetaTrader 5" from the App Store or Google Play. You will log in with the Exness credentials from your Exness account (steps 3–4), not a separate MetaQuotes-only account.
start.brokerStep3_body: Log in to Exness Personal Area (web or Exness app). Go to Accounts → New account → choose Demo → MetaTrader 5. Note the server name (e.g. Exness-MT5Trial or similar) and your demo login and password. Keep them private.
start.brokerStep4_title: 4. Log in to MetaTrader 5 with demo
start.brokerStep4_body: Open MetaTrader 5. Use File → Login to Trade Account, or enter details on the first screen. Server: paste or select the exact Exness demo server name from your Exness email. Login and password: from step 3. Press Login — you should see balance in demo currency in the Terminal.
start.brokerStep5_body: Open Market Watch (Ctrl+M on desktop). If XAUUSD is missing: right-click Market Watch → Symbols → Metals → add XAUUSD and show. Double-click XAUUSD (or New Order). Set Volume to 0.01 lots. Confirm order type is market execution. Click Buy. The position appears under Terminal → Trade. Close when you want — practice only; no profit goal.
start.brokerStep5_ctaQuotes: View XAUUSD on Social Forex quotes
start.closingHint: For theory (risk, spreads, news), continue with the Academy after you have tried this practice flow. You can compare gold prices on our quotes page.
start.aiAssistantIntro: Paste the text below into your assistant so it knows you are following the Exness + MT5 demo path on this site.

schemaFaq.q1: What is this Start page for?
schemaFaq.a1: It is a hands-on path: register Exness, install MT5, open a demo account, log in, then practice a small buy on XAUUSD. Theory is in the Academy.
schemaFaq.a2: No. Social Forex does not provide investment advice. Broker screens and product names may change; follow Exness and MetaQuotes official documentation.
schemaFaq.q3: Why is there an affiliate link?
schemaFaq.a3: The Exness registration link may earn us a commission. It does not change your price. You do not have to use Exness to trade — this is one supported path for beginners.
schemaFaq.q4: Is MT5 the same as Exness?
schemaFaq.a4: MT5 is MetaQuotes software. Exness is your broker. You log in to MT5 with the Exness demo credentials and server your broker gives you.

mt5.subtitle: The EA bridge reads account info, equity, and open positions from MT5, then sends them to Social Forex. This MVP syncs data only and does not place trades.
mt5.createDesc: Create a token for the EA. The token is shown once, then pasted into the EA inputs inside MT5.
mt5.tokenHint: Copy this token now. Social Forex stores only a hash and cannot show the raw token again.
mt5.setupDesc: Download the compiled EA (.ex5), install it in MT5 and connect with the token from the left.
mt5.downloadHint: Compiled EA · MT5 build 4+ · read-only, no automated trading
mt5.setupStep1: Create a token in the "Create bridge token" card on the left and copy it immediately (shown only once).
mt5.setupStep2: Download social-forex.ex5 above and copy it into the MT5 MQL5/Experts folder.
mt5.setupStep3: Restart MT5 or right-click Navigator → Refresh.
mt5.setupStep4: Go to Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL.
mt5.setupStep5: Add your Social Forex domain to the list, e.g. https://www.toolforex.xyz
mt5.setupStep6: Drag SocialForexBridge from the Navigator onto any chart.
mt5.setupStep7: In the EA settings dialog: set BridgeEndpoint to the endpoint shown below.
mt5.setupStep8: Set BridgeToken to the token you created, HeartbeatSeconds to 30 or higher.
mt5.setupStep9: Enable Algo Trading in MT5. The MT5 page will show "Connected" after the first heartbeat.
mt5.riskNote: Do not enter your MT5 password into Social Forex. The bridge receives read-only data only; no automated trading is included.

copyTrade.title: Copy Trading
copyTrade.configureHint: Configure how to copy trades from {name}.
copyTrade.percentHint: Max 10% of account balance per trade.
copyTrade.setupInstructions: Copy this token into the SocialForexCopyTrade EA in MetaTrader 5.
copyTrade.step1: Download SocialForexCopyTrade.mq5 to your MT5 Experts folder.
copyTrade.step3: Attach the EA to any chart and paste the token above.
copyTrade.step4: Enable Algo Trading. The EA will auto-copy new signals.
copyTrade.warning: Copy trading involves risk. Only risk what you can afford to lose. The EA will open trades automatically.
copyTrade.step1Desc: Browse the leaderboard or signal room to find a profitable trader.
copyTrade.step1Detail1: Go to Leaderboard to see top traders by win rate and profit factor
copyTrade.step1Detail2: Check their profile for performance stats and trade history
copyTrade.step1Detail3: Click Follow to track their signals
copyTrade.step2Desc: Choose how to size your positions when copying trades.
copyTrade.step2Detail1: Fixed Lot: Use the same lot size for every trade (e.g., 0.01)
copyTrade.step2Detail2: % of Account: Auto-calculate lot based on risk % (max 10%)
copyTrade.step3Desc: After subscribing, you'll receive a unique token.
copyTrade.step3Detail1: Copy the token — it looks like ct_abc12345
copyTrade.step3Detail2: Keep it safe — anyone with this token can copy to your account
copyTrade.step4Desc: Download and install the Copy Trading Expert Advisor.
copyTrade.step4Detail2: Copy it to MQL5/Experts/ folder in your MT5 data directory
copyTrade.step4Detail3: Restart MT5 or refresh Navigator panel
copyTrade.step5Desc: Attach the EA and start auto-copying trades.
copyTrade.step5Detail1: Drag EA to any chart, paste your token in settings
copyTrade.step5Detail2: Enable Algo Trading — EA will auto-copy new signals
copyTrade.warningText: Copy trading involves significant risk. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Only risk capital you can afford to lose. You are responsible for all trades executed by the EA.
copyTrade.metaTitle: Copy Trade MT5 Guide — Social Forex
copyTrade.metaDescription: Step-by-step guide to auto copy trade via MetaTrader 5 from Social Forex. Find a trader, get your token, install the EA and start copying.
copyTrade.heroDesc: Auto-copy trades from the top traders directly into your MT5 account — no need to watch charts all day.
copyTrade.req1: MetaTrader 5 installed and logged into an account (live or demo)
copyTrade.req3: Subscribed to copy at least 1 trader
copyTrade.req4: Social Forex URL whitelisted in MT5 WebRequest settings
copyTrade.step1Tip: Filter for traders with win rate > 55% and profit factor > 1.3 for a positive statistical edge.
copyTrade.step2Detail3: Fixed Lot — easy to control, good for beginners (e.g. 0.01 lot)
copyTrade.step2Detail4: % of Account — auto-calculates lot based on SL, equal risk per trade
copyTrade.step2Detail5: Click "Start Copying" to receive your unique token
copyTrade.step3Detail3: Token is a cuid, e.g.: cmnvefxa4000004l8sww5hzyx
copyTrade.tokenWarning: Anyone with this token can activate the EA to copy into your MT5 account. Do not share it.
copyTrade.step4PathHint: Folder path: File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts
copyTrade.step4AllowUrl: Add URL to whitelist: Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → Allow WebRequest for listed URL
copyTrade.step5Title: Configure and Attach the EA to a Chart
copyTrade.step5Desc: Drag the EA from Navigator onto any chart, paste your token and adjust parameters.
copyTrade.step5Detail1: Navigator → Expert Advisors → SocialForexCopyTrade → drag onto chart
copyTrade.step5Detail2: Paste your token into the CopyToken field
copyTrade.step5Detail3: Set AllowAutoTrade = true so the EA places real trades
copyTrade.step5Detail4: Click OK to start the EA
copyTrade.step6Desc: The EA polls every 10 seconds and opens trades automatically when a new signal appears.
copyTrade.step6Detail1: Click the Algo Trading button on the MT5 toolbar (▶ green icon) — must be re-enabled every time you open MT5
copyTrade.step6Detail2: The EA prints logs in the Journal tab in MT5 — monitor there
copyTrade.step6Detail3: Every copied trade has the comment "SocialForex Copy" for easy identification
copyTrade.step6AlgoNote: There are 2 separate switches: (1) the checkbox in Tools → Options → Expert Advisors is a permanent global setting, (2) the Algo Trading toolbar button is a per-session toggle — must be turned on every time you restart MT5. If the Journal shows Retcode=10027, the toolbar button is OFF.
copyTrade.param_endpoint_desc: Signal server URL — no need to change
copyTrade.param_token_desc: Copy token received from Social Forex
copyTrade.param_poll_desc: How often to check for new signals (seconds)
copyTrade.param_magic_desc: ID used by the EA to identify its own trades
copyTrade.ts1Q: EA doesn't place trades even when there are new signals
copyTrade.ts1A: Check that Algo Trading is enabled (green play button on toolbar). Also verify AllowAutoTrade = true in EA settings.
copyTrade.ts2A: MT5 hasn't whitelisted the URL. Go to Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → Allow WebRequest → add https://www.toolforex.xyz
copyTrade.ts3A: Token was revoked or subscription is no longer active. Go to the trader's profile → Copy → get a new token.
copyTrade.ts4A: Increase MaxSlippage to 50–100 points, or switch to an ECN/STP account with tighter spreads.
